---
title: Risotto with Cuttlefish
id: MAR-0103
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 65
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 300 g cuttlefish
- 280 g rice
- 1 tablespoon parsley
- 2 anchovy fillets
- 2 garlic cloves
- 9 dl fish stock
- 1 dl tomato sauce
- 10 g butter
- 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
## Method
1. Cut the cuttlefish into thick strips.
2. Heat the oil in a pan, add the peeled garlic, let it wilt for 5 minutes and remove it.
3. Add the cuttlefish and let them flavor for 3-4 minutes.
4. Chop the anchovy fillets and dissolve them in the cooking juices, then moisten with a ladle of broth, add the tomato sauce and parsley, mix and let cook for 40 minutes.
5. In a saucepan, melt the butter and toast the rice for one minute.
6. Pour the boiling broth one ladle at a time, so that the liquid just covers the surface of the rice, and cook until done.
7. Add the cuttlefish, mix and serve.
